name: Chiccha na Hanayome ~Mada Mada Tsubomi da mon~
original_name: ちっちゃな花嫁 ～まだまだつぼみだもんっ～
source:
Keita works at a flower shop, taking care of the storefront and doing deliveries on behalf of the scary-looking manager. He mostly makes deliveries to the town’s large cultural center, where events are held almost every week, including piano recitals, ballet performances, art contests and drama shows. He delivers flower bouquets of celebration and support to the site. When he saw the girls who were trying their best to achieve their dreams, he remembered his own dream which he had given up on. He wanted to make clothes for girls, specifically wedding dresses. What will become of his and the girls’ dreams?

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2017/01/01/january-2017-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
惠太在花店工作，替面相凶恶的店长照看店面、配送鲜花。他最常送货的地方是镇上的大型文化中心，那里几乎每周都会举办活动，包括钢琴演奏会、芭蕾演出、美术比赛和戏剧表演。他把饱含祝贺与鼓励的花束送到活动现场。

看着女孩们为实现梦想全力以赴，他想起了自己早已放弃的梦想：为女孩们制作衣服，尤其是婚纱。他与女孩们的梦想最终会怎样呢？

（来源：[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2017/01/01/january-2017-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]）
